description_en: Queries the list of clients connected to a specified hybrid cloud proxy by paging. This operation is part of the hybrid cloud proxy feature
description_zh: 该接口是混合云代理功能的一部分，通过该接口可以分页查询连接到指定混合云代理的客户端列表信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-hybrid-proxy-linked-client-list --proxy-uuid inet-proxy-3bb11fad-37d6-4aee-9c37-b0ad1612XXXX --cluster-name office-proxy --uuid 80d2f7d6-31a9-4d7f-8ff4-7ecc42f89ca0000 --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --remark test --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridProxyLinkedClientList

parameters.description_en: The UUID of the proxy node. You can call the DescribeHybridProxyList operation to obtain this value.
